description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods—labeled on the horizontal axis as "Standard," "Self-RAG," "FactTune," "ClinGS (w/)," and a grey bar with no label—measured on a vertical axis titled "Average Performance" that ranges from 0 to 60 in linear increments, with tick marks every 10 units. The bars are arranged horizontally in the order listed, from left to right, and are not sorted by height. The "Standard" method is represented by an orange bar with an approximate value of 55. The "Self-RAG" method is shown by a beige bar, also approximately 55. The "FactTune" method is depicted by a green bar with a value of approximately 53. The "ClinGS (w/)" method is shown by a blue bar, also approximately 55. The final, unlabeled grey bar has a value of approximately 60. All bars are solid-colored, uniformly thick, and visually emphasized by being outlined with a black border. There is no legend provided to explain the grey bar or any other color coding beyond the direct labeling of the methods on the x-axis.
